A **driver** talks to a storage system; an **engine** runs the computation. They are orthogonal: any engine can read from any driver it has a staging strategy for. Concepts: [Connections & addresses](../02-concepts/storage.md), [Engines](../02-concepts/engines.md).

## Drivers

| Type | Description | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access` | Microsoft Access file endpoint. No secrets. | native |
| `azure_blob` | Azure Blob Storage endpoint. | native |
| `databricks` | Databricks SQL Warehouse endpoint. Secret: personal access token. | legacy adapter (DuckDB only) |
| `disc` | Filesystem endpoint. No secrets. | native |
| `gcs` | GCS endpoint. Secret: service-account JSON. | legacy adapter (DuckDB only) |
| `mssql` | MSSQL server endpoint. Secret: password. | legacy adapter (DuckDB only) |
| `postgres` | PostgreSQL server endpoint. Secret: password. | legacy adapter (DuckDB only) |
| `s3` | S3 (and S3-compatible) endpoint. Secrets: AWS credential triplet. | native |
| `snowflake` | Snowflake account endpoint. | native |

## Engines

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `databricks_spark` | Databricks-Connect-backed engine. |
| `duckdb` | Concrete `BaseEngine` backed by an in-process DuckDB connection. |
| `pyspark` | Concrete `BaseEngine` backed by a single `SparkSession`. |
| `snowpark` | Concrete `BaseEngine` backed by a Snowpark session. |
